comment: PTM3D science-data catalog, consumed by scripts/fetch_data.py. base_url is a placeholder until the public (Zenodo) deposit is published; pass --base-url to fetch from a staging copy. SHA-256 checksums and sizes are pinned from the staged v1 archives (2026-07-29).

moon-topo.attribution: Derived from LRO LOLA LDEM (Smith et al. 2010); NASA PDS public domain

moon-property-maps.description: Diviner-derived lunar property maps: H-parameter, maria mask, TI@273K (ico3-ico9)
moon-property-maps.attribution: Diviner heritage (Hayne et al. 2017; Paige et al. 2010); NASA PDS public domain

albedo-maps.description: Moon + Europa Bond-albedo maps (per-face binaries res3-res9 + source FITS)
albedo-maps.attribution: Derived from NASA PDS mission data (LRO; Voyager/Galileo)

validation-meshes.description: Diviner-validation crater meshes + view factors (Haworth/Faustini/Shackleton/sunlit) + LOLA 20 m rasters
validation-meshes.attribution: Derived from LRO LOLA (Smith et al. 2010); validation vs Diviner (Paige et al. 2010)

copernicus-dem.description: Copernicus crater DEM crop (SLDEM2015 512 ppd) + hillshade/color products
copernicus-dem.attribution: SLDEM2015 (Barker et al. 2016); NASA PDS public domain

moon3d-mesh.attribution: Derived from LRO LOLA LDEM (Smith et al. 2010); NASA PDS public domain

planned_optional_datasets.comment: Not yet staged (very large; hydration + deposit deferred to the P2/P4 upload session): moon-topo-hires (topo_moon_ico10/ico11, ~9.2 GB) and diviner-seasonal-full (raw .txt exports, ~1.7 GB). They will be added as tier=optional entries with pinned hashes when deposited.
